record.one_liner: Clay is a GTM data enrichment and workflow platform that combines data providers, AI research and CRM/outbound automation.
record.auth_notes: Public API requests send a Clay API key in the clay-api-key header. Keys are created under API and CLI > API keys (or clay api-keys create). The legacy account API key does not work with the Public API. Not OAuth.
record.access_notes: critic: access contact_sales -> paid_plan. Clay API access is listed only on the Enterprise tier (custom pricing, annual commitment); Free, Launch and Growth plans do not list it (Growth lists HTTP API integrations, a different feature). The rubric treats 'Enterprise only' API access as paid_plan. No free or trial path to the Public API found.
record.api_notes: Public API base is https://api.clay.com/public/v0 with a documented /me endpoint. Breadth of endpoints not fully surveyed. Tables also accept per-table webhook ingestion on lower tiers, which is not the public REST API.
record.blocker_notes: critic: main_blocker contact_sales -> paid_plan to match access. Public API requires the Enterprise plan. The official MCP server (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) is a hosted workspace connector, not a developer-issued API credential.

evidence.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the clay-api-key header.
Includes everything in Growth, plus unlimited Audiences across sources, unlimited row bulk enrichment, Clay API access
Clay's MCP server uses it to expose 150+ data providers, AI research agents, and your team's prebuilt workflows inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex.
